headline: Warden Recaptures Reverse Northern Lines Across Weathered Expanse and Mooring
war_summary: Since our previous filing, Warden counteractions have reversed recent Colonial gains across the northern theatre, shifting the contested balance in Weathered Expanse to four Warden strongholds, two Colonial garrisons, and three abandoned ruins following a ferocious twelve-event struggle in the past two hours alone. Mooring County also tipped further into Warden control, leaving the faction with ten strongholds to two Colonial footholds as fighting flared anew around Gravekeeper's Holdfast with six rapid state changes. In Callahan's Passage, renewed clashes at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage yielded three fresh base transfers amid sharply accelerating casualties on both sides. Meanwhile, the bloody standoff along Nevish Line has settled into a six-to-two Warden majority without further ground shifting in the last two hours, despite hundreds of fresh casualties. Across Dead Lands, heavy exchanges pushed combined losses past eight hundred without disturbing Colonial control of ten garrisons and one neutral sector. Secondary island and coastal fronts in Kuura Strand, Fishermans Row, and Palantine Berm have lapsed into complete operational stillness.
